info.description: Scan a QR code to view vehicle owner info and send them a message.
info.title: QR-Parking API

patch.summary: Update admin password and/or role (super_admin only)

get.summary: Dashboard statistics with user growth chart

get.description: series: clients — new users per day; qr_created — qr_codes.created_at; qr_activated — qr_codes.registered_at (active claim).
get.summary: Time series for dashboard chart (clients / QR created / QR activated per day)

post.description: Authenticates admin with username/password and returns JWT with admin_session=true

get.summary: List QR codes (paginated, filterable by status)

parameters.description: QR code string or numeric id
parameters.name: id

get.summary: Get full user details with vehicles, messages, qr codes
List QR codes for a user

get.description: Returns the authenticated owner's full profile including vehicles and socials.

patch.description:
Updates the authenticated owner's name, avatar and social profiles.
Send null/omit a field to leave it unchanged; send "" to delete a social link.

get.description: Returns all vehicles belonging to the authenticated owner.

patch.description:
Updates a vehicle that belongs to the authenticated owner.
Omit a field to leave it unchanged.

post.description: Saves the message and sends a Telegram notification to the owner if they have the bot linked.
post.summary: Send a message to the QR owner

parameters.description: Message text (1–500 chars) and optional media_url
parameters.name: body

post.description:
Verifies the OTP, creates or links the user by phone,
then returns an access token valid for 30 days.
If the QR is already registered: owner phone → owner token; else if phone exists in DB → that account's token.
post.summary: Verify OTP and register the QR code

get.description:
Returns the full owner profile and vehicle linked to this QR code.
Returns {"registered":false} if the code is not yet claimed.

post.description:
Validates the QR code and sends a 6-digit OTP to the given phone number.
The OTP is valid for 5 minutes.

get.summary: Get QR code as PNG image

post.description: Upload a media file (image or video) to attach to a message. Max 20MB.
